ops.title: Index active long-running clocks without reading every lane database
ops.description: Owner:/root. User selected the next Go long-running I/O repair after automatic replay removal. Current liveClocks calls containers(lanePrefix), reads all lane SQLite databases and checks incident-clock/ended on each flush. Replace that scan with an existing-storage-based active lookup, preserving clock creation/end behavior, external-reader freshness and all current user behavior. Next: inspect every clock writer and current store/index helpers, reproduce cost through bounded source/read-count regression in hosted CI, implement one authoritative indexed representation and perform one explicit existing-data migration if needed. No local replay/load/stress tests, no new model workers beyond the existing exhausted budget; preserve all sessions and unrelated changes. Other campaign work stays held.

ops.text: Active-clock reads use an indexed active set and do not enumerate/query unrelated lane databases at any historical lane count
Clock create/update/end paths preserve behavior, and hosted regression/performance-contract checks pass
Source merged, coherent signed release published, installed runtime adopted it, actual metadata/passive activity verified without local load tests or session interruption
